discovery_notes: Cell B022 (Disney Store UK/EU + US/shopDisney, 2017). 30 standard searches, snippets only. UP! New Year 2018 pin (released 19 Dec 2017) skipped: already keyed in 214 as dsuk/2018. Disney Store 30th Anniversary weekly 3-packs: one pin per named film is an inference (no source states the split); Week 8 contents not found. Coco set pins keyed one per named character (assumed). Minnie Signature set keyed once under dsuk (UK first, 14 Feb 2017) with US release claims (9 Mar 2017). Park Pack 3.0 started Sep 2017 (DPB); Hello Subscription conflicts on Nov/Dec themes and lists a Sep 2017 '2.0' box. Reseller yourwdwstore.net seen but not used. No licensed leads found.
